prompt: CHALLENGE: CFCs (e.g., CF₂Cl₂) deplete stratospheric ozone via radical chemistry. The first catalytic step involves:

options.label: UV photolysis of a C–Cl bond releases Cl•, which then attacks O₃: Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂.
The whole CFC molecule reacts intact with O₃.
Hydrolysis of the CFC releases HCl.

explanation: Stratospheric UV cleaves the weakest C–X in a CFC (C–Cl) to Cl•. Cl• then catalytically destroys O₃: Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂; ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂. One Cl atom can destroy ~10⁵ O₃ molecules before being removed.
